description: Anti-pattern decision thresholds (anti-cliche / anti-AI artefacts). CAS-AP-GATE-* are the sheet-audience thresholds of design-compiler's five anti-pattern gates (ANTI-01..05; ANTI-06 is an evidence-integrity check and carries no aesthetic number). CAS-AP-CLICHE-* are the engine-only thresholds and scores of lib/cliche-detector.js: they never reach a sheet.

rules.title: Dead void gate (ANTI-03): a large void that has no function (no texture, no atmospheric gradient, no tonal variation)

payload.subject: dead-void
payload.rationale: Dead void (假留白死黑/死白) = a LARGE void with NO function: pixel void share and largest void region above their cut-offs AND texture, atmospheric gradient and tonal spread below theirs (留白必须有功能; 留白区域无功能 is P0 in void-solid.md). candidate_void_ratio_above is a dead-void CANDIDATE test on the pixel estimator, not a void_ratio band and not the structural signal (ADR-0001). No depth evidence caps the verdict at FLAG (UNMEASURED != FAIL). confidence_* = verdict confidence reported by the gate.

rules.title: Toxic saturation gate (ANTI-05): fluorescent colour pollution judged on pixel proxies, relaxed for the high-saturation paradigm

payload.subject: toxic-saturation
payload.rationale: No HSV statistics exist in the evidence set, so fluorescent colour pollution is judged on proxies: dominant-colour share, contrast and colour-temperature bias above, luminance spread below their cut-offs (DC proxies, not guideline numbers; color.md only bans neon / fluorescent hues). Paradigms in high_saturation_paradigms (唐三彩) are exempt from REJECT and the low-variation FLAG clause; confidence_allow_paradigm sits in an unreachable branch. confidence_* = reported verdict confidence.

rules.title: Unphysical glow gate (ANTI-02): homogeneous surface with sharp, significant specular highlights (plastic highlight)

payload.subject: unphysical-glow
payload.rationale: Plastic highlight / non-physical self-illumination needs BOTH a homogeneous surface (micro-surface variance below its cut-off) AND sharp, significant specular highlights (sharpness and pixel share above theirs); one condition alone is no anti-pattern (matte materials are homogeneous). The cut-offs are DC measurements on material evidence; taboo.md only prescribes roughness + highlight detection. confidence_* = reported verdict confidence.

rules.title: Symbolic stacking gate (ANTI-01): many weakly connected nodes without host-guest rule or convergence

payload.subject: symbolic-stacking
payload.rationale: Symbolic stacking (符号化机械堆砌) is a graph-topology verdict, never an object count. Signals: many nodes, low average degree, no HOST_GUEST edge, no convergence (max in-degree below convergence_in_degree_min). REJECT needs reject_severe_signals_min signals AND isolated_nodes_min isolated nodes; FLAG needs flag_severe_signals_min signals. many_nodes_min is the value the DC gate executed; its header comment said 4, the code said 8 and wins. confidence_* = reported verdict confidence.

rules.title: Conflicted hierarchy gate (ANTI-04): competing subjects of near-equal energy without host-guest subordination

payload.subject: conflicted-hierarchy
payload.rationale: Conflicted hierarchy (主从混乱 / 多主冲突, against 宾主揖让): two or more SUBJECT nodes whose relative energy difference (max-min)/max is below close_energy_diff_ratio_below and with no HOST_GUEST edge between subjects => REJECT; multiple subjects with only one of the two signals => FLAG. A single subject, or clearly graded subjects, is never in conflict. confidence_* = reported verdict confidence.

rules.title: Cliche detector: hard-fail thresholds stated verbatim by the guidelines

payload.subject: cliche-guideline-thresholds
payload.rationale: Thresholds of the four cliche types that taboo.md / color.md / material.md state verbatim: traditional-pattern coverage, frontal-face person area, building detail without block silhouette, mean saturation hard cap, plastic roughness / metalness. Engine-only. taboo.md judges AI国风 by saturation AND material smoothness; the engine applies the saturation cap on its own (kept as shipped).

rules.title: Cliche detector: cut-offs and neutral defaults authored in the engine itself

payload.subject: cliche-engine-thresholds
payload.rationale: Cut-offs no guideline states: oversized person, ornate-costume detail, flat light (明暗比 below flat_lighting_ratio_below; a missing ratio counts as brightness_ratio_default), too many main elements, PBR defaults for missing material fields, and the number of AI-look hits that decides detection. light-shadow.md uses 3:1 and recommends >= 5:1 where the engine flags below 2:1 (not reconciled). Engine-only.

rules.title: Cliche detector scoring: 国潮贴图感

payload.subject: cliche-guochao-scoring
payload.rationale: Score added per violation, the score from which the type counts as detected, and its weight in the overall cliche score (the four type weights sum to 1). Engine-authored, no guideline states them. Engine-only.
